newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danske Bank climbs on lack of sellers.
newsitem.headline: Danske Bank climbs on lack of sellers.

text.p: Shares in leading Danish bank Den Danske soared four percent on Friday, putting on 28 crowns from Thursday's close to trade at 715 due to a dearth of sellers, dealers said.
"The rise seems somewhat exaggerated as there is no market moving news to justify it. A dearth of sellers could be the main reason," one dealer said.
Danish bank stock has generally noted solid advances in recent days with Den Danske Bank rising 10 percent this week.
Another dealer attributed the rises to market expectations that banks would make major earnings this year from securities.
